frontmatter.title: Content Security Policy (CSP): A Brutally Honest Guide to a More Secure Web
frontmatter.subheading: Why Most Websites Are Still Vulnerable-and How CSP Can Actually Fix It (If You Use It Right)
frontmatter.excerpt: Struggling with XSS attacks, data breaches, or third-party script risks? Content Security Policy (CSP) is your first line of defense-but only if you implement it correctly. This no-BS guide covers real-world CSP failures, practical setups, and why 90% of developers get it wrong. Learn how to harden your web app, avoid common pitfalls, and sleep better at night.
frontmatter.author: Paul Serban
